name: page-naming-convention
description: Enforce consistent page naming convention where page components should end with 'Page'
message:
Page components should end with 'Page'. For example:
- 'Login.razor' → 'LoginPage.razor'
- 'Authentication.razor' → 'AuthenticationPage.razor'
- 'Main.razor' → 'MainPage.razor'
- 'Index.razor' → 'IndexPage.razor'
- 'Settings.razor' → 'SettingsPage.razor'
- 'Issues.razor' → 'IssueListPage.razor'
- 'Issue.razor' → 'IssueDetailsPage.razor'
